goal: Avoid penalizing remote peer addresses when a node has connectivity issues on only one network
Prevent local reachability loss on networks like Tor or IPv6 from halting relay of good addresses
reviewability: Author has been silent for over two months, so new reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Contested objection: unreachable network addresses could accumulate indefinitely in the table (stratospher)
Verified by testing isolated network failure scenarios on mainnet (naiyoma)
Approval with request to document trade-offs for unreachable networks (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because partial network outages currently cause nodes to penalize valid peers on other networks
A local reachability failure can otherwise suppress address relay across the wider network
